full_text_zh:
[P1] 笑里藏刀
！

[P2] 北宋有一位常胜将军，名叫曹玮。曹玮十九岁就做了将领，戍守西北四十年，从来没有打过败仗，就连他的敌人都非常敬佩他。吐蕃的统领只要一听到曹玮的名字，就会尊敬地将双手合十，放到额头上。契丹的使者经过曹玮的兵营时，还命令部下：‘曹公在这里，放慢马速轻声些，不要吵到他。’

[P3] 曹玮刚到渭州当守将的时候，有很多宋兵投敌到西夏。有一天，他正在和客人下棋，有个部将慌里慌张地闯了进来，向他报告："将军，今天又有五十多个士兵叛逃西夏去了。"曹玮听了，微微一笑，不慌不忙地落下一枚棋子，缓缓说道："知道了，慌什么，不用追，那是我派出去的！"

[P4] 宋军中的西夏暗探听了，赶紧把这个情报送了回去。“原来是这样！”西夏军的主将恍然大悟，“来人啊，所有投诚过来的宋兵，都给我斩了！”，

[P5] 中计啦！
杀了降兵后，西夏军的主将仔细一想："不好，我们中了曹玮的奸计！"
他后悔得捶胸顿足，曹玮却高兴得哈哈大笑。从此以后，宋朝的士兵再也不敢往西夏逃了。

[P6] 曹玮驻守镇戎的时候，吐蕃的军队
一见到曹玮的军旗，转身就跑。曹
玮对部下说："这样猫捉老鼠也不
是办法，我们得想法子把他们引
来，彻底消灭，才能解除后患呀！"

[P7] 有一次，曹玮带着兵马偷袭了一个吐蕃军队的营地。刚一交战，吐蕃军队就丢下牛羊和帐篷，骑着马飞快地逃跑了。曹玮一边派侦察兵远远地跟着，一边让士兵们把吐蕃人留下的武器、帐篷装上车，赶着缴获的牛羊往回走。

[P8] 一路上，牛“哞哞哞”，羊“咩咩咩”，一会儿往左冲，一会儿往右逃。士兵们忙着赶牛羊，整齐的队伍一下子乱了套。装满武器和帐篷的马车很笨重，路又坑坑洼洼的不平整，马车一不小心陷进了坑里，还得让十几个士兵推出来。

[P9] 这么慢吞吞地走下去，什么时候才能回到军营？一位性急的部下劝曹玮说：‘将军，这些牛羊在战场上一点用都没有，我们还是把它们丢下，赶紧回去吧！’曹玮却笑着说：‘不用着急！’

[P10] 吐蕃人逃出上百里路后，又派人悄悄回来查探。哇，好家伙，宋军赶着牛羊和马车，队伍稀稀拉拉有几里长。这正是还击的好时候呀！一个冲锋，就能杀得宋军片甲不留！吐蕃的暗探马不停蹄地赶回去，向统领报告了这个好消息。

[P11] "急行军，去把我们的东西抢回来！"吐蕃人扬起马鞭狂奔过来。曹玮的侦察兵赶回来报告了吐蕃人的动静。可是，曹玮不但没有加快行军速度，反而让大家在一个山坡上停了下来，杀牛宰羊，埋锅造饭，大吃了起来。

[P12] 宋军吃饱了饭，浑身上下都是劲儿。没过多时，吐蕃人就赶来了。曹玮看他们气喘吁吁，笑了笑，派人去喊话：‘你们远道而来，一定很累了。我们不想趁人疲劳的时候作战，请让你们的士兵和马先休息一下，稍后我们再决一死战。’

[P13] 吐蕃人一口气跑了一百多里路，正担心没有力气战斗呢。他们的统领很高兴，马上命令士兵们排好阵形，坐下来休息。过了好一会儿，曹玮又派人过来问：‘你们休息好了没有？歇好了就放马过来吧！’

[P14] "咚咚咚！"两军战鼓齐鸣。吐蕃人骑着马往山坡上冲，而宋军占据了有利的地形，纵马从山坡上冲下来。一个回合，吐蕃人就被打得落花流水，大败而逃。打了胜仗，曹玮这才扔下那些牛羊和帐篷，带着士兵们回营去了。

[P15] 为什么要赶着牛羊慢慢走？为什么要让吐蕃人休息过后再开战？许多士兵疑惑不解，曹玮笑着说："我是故意装作舍不得牛羊，赶着它们慢吞吞地往回走，引吐蕃人追过来的。他们刚追来的时候，士气高昂，如果我们立刻迎战，伤亡一定会很大，所以我让他们先休息一会儿。"

[P16] "跑了那么远的路，休息一会儿，腿就会又疼又麻，站不起来，士气也低迷了。我们以逸待劳，又有地理优势，这一仗必胜无疑！"西夏人的暗探和吐蕃人的统领，被曹玮的笑容和友善迷惑，没有看出背后隐藏的杀机，这才中了计。这样的计策就叫"笑里藏刀"。
full_text_en:
[P1] Smiling with a hidden knife
!

[P2] In the Northern Song Dynasty, there was a renowned general named Cao Wei. At nineteen, Cao Wei became a commander and guarded the northwest for forty years without ever suffering a defeat. Even his enemies greatly respected him. When the leader of Tubo heard Cao Wei's name, he would respectfully press his hands together and place them on his forehead. When envoys from the Khitan passed through Cao Wei's camp, they would order their subordinates: 'General Cao is here. Slow down your horses and speak softly—do not disturb him.'

[P3] When Cao Wei first arrived in Weizhou as commander, many Song soldiers defected to the Western Xia. One day, while he was playing chess with a guest, a subordinate officer rushed in anxiously and reported: "General, today another fifty or so soldiers have defected to the Western Xia." Cao Wei listened, smiled faintly, calmly placed a chess piece, and slowly said: "I know, don't worry, no need to chase them—they were sent out by me!"

[P4] The Western Xia spy in the Song army heard this and quickly sent the intelligence back. “So that’s how it is!” the Western Xia commander suddenly realized. “Bring me the soldiers who defected from the Song army—execute them all!”

[P5] Got tricked!
After killing the defectors, the Xixia army's commander thought carefully: "Oh no, we've fallen for Cao Wei's treacherous plot!"
He regretted it deeply, pounding his chest in despair, while Cao Wei laughed heartily. From then on, Song soldiers dared not flee to Xixia anymore.

[P6] When Cao Wei was stationed at Zhenrong, the Tibetan army
would turn and flee as soon as they saw Cao Wei's military banner. Cao
Wei told his subordinates: "This method of catching mice like a cat is not
a solution. We must find a way to lure them in, eliminate them completely,
and only then can we remove this lingering threat!"

[P7] Once, Cao Wei led his troops to secretly attack a Tibetan army camp. As soon as the battle began, the Tibetan army dropped their cattle, sheep, and tents and fled quickly on horseback. Cao Wei sent scouts to follow them from a distance, while ordering his soldiers to load the weapons and tents left behind by the Tibetans onto carts and drive the captured cattle and sheep back.

[P8] Along the way, the cows mooed 'moo moo moo' and the sheep bleated 'baa baa baa', charging left and then right. The soldiers were busy herding the cattle and sheep, and the neat formation quickly fell into chaos. The carts loaded with weapons and tents were very heavy, and the road was uneven and bumpy. The cart accidentally got stuck in a pit, and it took more than ten soldiers to push it out.

[P9] Moving so slowly, when will we get back to camp? An impatient subordinate urged Cao Wei: 'General, these cattle and sheep are useless on the battlefield. Let's leave them behind and hurry back!' Cao Wei smiled and said: 'Don't worry!'

[P10] After the Tubo people fled over a hundred li, they sent someone secretly to scout. Wow, look at this! The Song army is herding cattle, sheep, and carts, with a scattered formation stretching for several li. This is the perfect moment to counterattack! With one charge, we could slaughter the Song army to the last man! The Tubo spy galloped back without stopping to report this good news to his commander.

[P11] "Quick march, go and retrieve our things!" The Tubo people galloped over, whipping their horses. Cao Wei's scouts returned and reported the Tubo's movements. However, Cao Wei did not speed up the army's march. Instead, he had everyone stop on a hillside, slaughter cattle and sheep, set up pots over fires, and began eating heartily.

[P12] The Song army had eaten their fill and were full of energy. Not long after, the Tubo forces arrived. Cao Wei saw them panting heavily, smiled, and sent someone to call out: 'You've come from afar and must be very tired. We don't want to fight while you're exhausted. Please let your soldiers and horses rest for a while. We'll settle this life-or-death battle later.'

[P13] The Tubo soldiers had run over a hundred li in one go and were worried they didn’t have the strength to fight. Their commander was very pleased and immediately ordered the soldiers to form ranks and sit down to rest. After a while, Cao Wei sent someone over to ask: ‘Have you rested enough? If you’re ready, send your horses over!’

[P14] "Dong dong dong!" The war drums of both armies beat in unison. The Tubo riders charged up the slope, while the Song army, having secured a favorable position, galloped down from the hill. In one round, the Tubo forces were routed, fleeing in disarray. After securing victory, Cao Wei finally abandoned the cattle, sheep, and tents, and led his soldiers back to camp.

[P15] Why are we moving the cattle and sheep so slowly? Why let the Tubo people rest before we fight? Many soldiers were puzzled. Cao Wei smiled and said: "I am deliberately pretending to be reluctant to part with the cattle and sheep, leading them back slowly to lure the Tubo people to chase us. When they first arrive, their morale is high. If we fight immediately, our casualties will be great. So I let them rest for a while."

[P16] "After running such a long distance, if we rest for a while, our legs will ache and numb, we won't be able to stand, and our morale will drop. We are resting while they are exhausted, and we have the advantage of terrain. This battle is surely ours!" The spies from the Western Xia and the leader of the Tibetan forces, deceived by Cao Wei's smile and friendly demeanor, failed to see the hidden danger behind it, and thus fell into the trap. This kind of strategy is called 'a smile hiding a knife.'
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页标题为“笑里藏刀”，画面中一名身穿铠甲的士兵跪坐在地，表情惊恐，身旁有一匹倒地的马和一个被丢弃的马鞍，上方有感叹号和飞出的刀，暗示士兵可能遭遇了背叛或陷阱。
[P2] 本页介绍了北宋名将曹玮的威望，描述他十九岁即为将领，戍守西北四十年未尝败绩，连敌对的吐蕃和契丹都对他极为敬重。
[P3] 本页讲述了曹玮初到渭州任守将时，面对部下报告士兵叛逃西夏，他从容不迫，称那些士兵是自己派出去的，展现了其沉着与谋略。
[P4] 西夏暗探将宋军内部情报带回，西夏主将恍然大悟，下令处决所有投诚的宋兵，揭示了曹玮计谋的高明之处。
[P5] 西夏主将发现中了曹玮的计谋后懊悔不已，而曹玮则得意大笑，从此宋军士兵再也不敢逃往西夏。
[P6] 曹玮驻守镇戎时，吐蕃军队一见其军旗便溃逃。他向部下表示，不能只靠威慑，而应设法引敌深入，彻底消灭，以除后患。
[P7] 曹玮率军偷袭吐蕃营地，敌军溃逃后，他派侦察兵跟踪，并让士兵收集战利品，安全撤回。
[P8] 画面描绘了宋军行军途中遭遇牛羊惊乱的场景，队伍因牲畜失控而混乱，笨重的马车还陷进了坑里，需多名士兵合力推出来。
[P9] 宋军行军途中遭遇牛羊惊乱，队伍陷入混乱，部下建议丢弃牲畜尽快回营，曹玮却从容不迫，表示无需着急。
[P10] 吐蕃人逃走后派暗探回查，发现宋军队伍混乱、拖着牛羊马车，误以为是好时机，遂将情报带回报告统领。
[P11] 曹玮得知吐蕃人前来抢夺战利品后，没有加快行军，反而在山坡上停下，杀牛宰羊，埋锅做饭，大吃起来，制造出宋军从容不迫的假象。
[P12] 曹玮在山坡上设下计谋，假装从容不迫地休息吃饭，向赶来的吐蕃军队喊话，声称要等对方休息后再决战，实则诱敌深入。
[P13] 吐蕃军队长途奔袭后疲惫不堪，曹玮趁机派使者挑衅，假装从容，诱使敌军放松警惕，为后续伏击创造条件。
[P14] 宋军与吐蕃军在山坡上交战，宋军凭借有利地形迅速击溃敌军，吐蕃人败逃。曹玮在取得胜利后，扔下战利品，带领士兵返回营地。
[P15] 曹玮向士兵解释，故意缓慢行军并让吐蕃人休息，是为了诱敌深入，避免在敌军士气高昂时交战，从而减少己方伤亡。
[P16] 画面描绘了吐蕃军队疲惫不堪地在山中行进，而曹玮则从容地坐在山坡上。文字解释了曹玮用‘笑里藏刀’之计，以从容姿态迷惑敌军，使其放松警惕，最终中计。
